title: Roast carrot and chickpea tray with feta

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole ingredient or a plain staple: carrots, onion, tinned chickpeas, kale, yoghurt, feta, honey and spices.

supermarket.reason: Every item is an everyday line at Tesco or any mainstream supermarket at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, board, roasting tray and small bowl, and simple roasting technique.

works.reason: Carrot fingers at 220°C for 25 minutes will be tender and browned, the quantities suit four lunches, and the seasoning and dressing are well judged.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers cutting the carrots, wedging an onion, draining tins, shredding kale and mixing the yoghurt, and the 25-minute cook matches the 20 plus 5 in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm roast-carrot traybake with kale suits a cold December lunch, and the carrots are clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English with no restaurant language or health preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling lunch of vegetables, chickpeas, yoghurt and feta that a family would happily eat again.
